description: You are a Search Marketing Strategist auditing the frontend resources of https://books.toscrape.com/ to identify performance bottlenecks. Use Screaming Frog SEO Spider to crawl the site. After the crawl is complete, you must: 1) Navigate to the 'CSS' tab and export the list of CSS resources to a CSV file in ~/Documents/SEO/exports/. 2) Navigate to the 'JavaScript' tab and export the list of JS resources to a SEPARATE CSV file in ~/Documents/SEO/exports/. 3) Write a brief optimization report at ~/Documents/SEO/reports/frontend_resources_report.txt that includes the total count of CSS files, total count of JS files, and any recommendations for optimization (e.g., minification, combining files).
